name: elsevier-research-mcp-utm
description: Search Scopus, get abstracts, open-access and ScienceDirect full text through the official Elsevier APIs, with institution download limits built in (UTM Library defaults: 5 articles and 100 MB per 15 min). Unofficial. Needs uv and an Elsevier API key (config file or ELSEVIER_API_KEY).
